summary: FocusTube: Complete Resolution for Educational Videos Being Wrongfully Blocked. Identified fatal collision words in blocked list (such as king colliding with Animal Kingdom/King Ashoka, beats colliding with Wave Beats, acoustic colliding with Acoustic Waves, singer colliding with Singer-Nicolson model, and natak colliding with Karnataka), removed auto-deletion on playlist view and app launch, and introduced a 1-tap 'Allow & Play' override in the player curtain.
